title: Mornington Tourist Railway, School Holiday Special Runs
summary: Heritage steam and diesel rides on selected Sundays and through school holiday breaks. 5km between Moorooduc and Mornington, vintage carriages, simple and good.
priceRange: Adults approx $25; children approx $15 (check website for current pricing)
recurrenceNote: Selected Sundays year-round + school holiday special runs (check website for exact dates)
suitableFor: Families with children; train enthusiasts; all ages
accessibilityNotes: Platform access; some steps into carriages; check accessibility with operator
suggestedItineraryPairing: Train ride + Moorooduc Station Market (if aligned) + Mornington beach
editorVerdict: Simple, unironic, properly run: a heritage steam ride that doesn't pretend to be anything more than what it is, which is exactly the appeal.
editorNote:
The Mornington Tourist Railway runs a 5km heritage line between Moorooduc and Mornington, with selected Sundays year-round and additional special runs during school holidays. Steam or diesel depending on the day, vintage carriages, volunteer-operated.

For general Sunday runs you can usually walk up. School holiday specials and themed events need booking. Check the website close to dates because the schedule shifts.

The extra trick is to align with the Moorooduc Station Market on the same site for a doubled-up morning. Adults around $25, kids $15.
kidsGradeNote: Train-mad kids will lose their minds; even the indifferent ones get something out of it. Bring snacks for the carriage.
